capabilities: Convert RedNotebook backup ZIPs into one note per day (YYYY-MM-DD.md)
Preview dates, existing notes, conflicts and markup reports before writing
Convert basic txt2tags markup to Markdown with a report of what was not converted
Map RedNotebook categories into note properties (Pro)
Merge converted days into a section of existing daily notes (Pro)
extras: Freemium: core import is free; category mapping and daily-note merge need a paid GitHub Sponsors tier with device-flow sign-in. The plugin is not reviewed by Obsidian staff, and after updates it opens a 'What's new' tab that promotes other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat (can be disabled in settings). Requires Obsidian 1.13.4 or later; mobile and some backup variants are untested.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to move an existing RedNotebook journal (monthly YAML files) into the vault as per-day Markdown notes.

relations.evidence: Move a local RedNotebook journal into dated Markdown notes.
The merge uses the fixed YYYY-MM-DD.md file name. It does not read the settings of the Daily notes core plugin.

requires.name: GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of theluckystrike ($5/month or $15 once)

summary: One-way importer that converts RedNotebook backup ZIPs into dated Markdown notes with converted txt2tags markup and category entries.
